message:
test(update): sending the answer and being refused is not the same as having nowhere to send it

The no-channel case skips the send; an unwritable channel attempts it and
is turned down. Different code paths, and both have to end with the caller
staying put -- so the second one gets its own case rather than being
assumed to follow from the first.

Forced deterministically by opening the acknowledgement with SYNCHRONIZE
only, so SetEvent fails with access denied. Closing a handle and passing it
in would have relied on undefined behaviour to produce the failure.
